quickAnswerTitle: How New Mexico School Calendars Differ in 2026–27
quickAnswer: New Mexico does not use one statewide student calendar. In the reviewed 2026–27 calendars, Las Cruces begins with transition grades on July 24 and other grades on July 27. Albuquerque begins grades 1–12 on August 7 and Pre-K and kindergarten on August 11. Breaks, conference formats, remote-learning dates, grading periods, and last days also differ by district.
about:
New Mexico public school calendars are published locally, so families need the calendar for their district, grade level, and program. The reviewed Albuquerque and Las Cruces calendars use different opening patterns, break dates, conference formats, grading-period structures, and year-end schedules.

Albuquerque Public Schools starts grades 1–12 on August 7, followed by Pre-K and kindergarten on August 11. Its parent-teacher conference dates in November and March are virtual learning days rather than ordinary districtwide holidays. Las Cruces Public Schools starts kindergarten, grade 6, and grade 9 on July 24, with the remaining listed grades starting July 27. It also identifies educator-planning dates with remote learning activities and separate no-school conference dates.

Use the district page for the complete reviewed calendar, official source, and one-time calendar download. School communications remain the best source for bell times, testing, athletics, graduation details, and program-specific changes.

faqs.q: Are New Mexico school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Districts publish their own calendars, so first days, breaks, conference formats, staff days, and last days can differ.

faqs.q: When do New Mexico schools start in 2026?
faqs.a: There is no single statewide first day. In the reviewed calendars, Las Cruces begins with transition grades July 24, while Albuquerque begins grades 1–12 August 7. Other grade groups start later in both districts.

faqs.q: When is New Mexico Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.a: Spring Break is district-specific. Las Cruces lists March 15–19, while Albuquerque lists March 22–25 followed by a Vernal Holiday on March 26.

faqs.q: Are parent-teacher conference days always days off?
faqs.a: No. APS labels its K–12 conference dates as virtual learning days. LCPS separately identifies educator-planning or remote-learning dates and conference dates with no school.

faqs.q: When does school resume after Winter Break?
faqs.a: APS students resume January 5, 2027, after a January 4 staff professional-development day. LCPS students resume January 6 after professional learning and teacher workdays on January 4–5.

faqs.q: Can I add a New Mexico school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. Reviewed district pages provide an ICS file that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. It is a one-time import, not a live district subscription.
